text:
Maria: Heads-up — tried to use Console's 'Publish' today and it immediately activated a config change instead of staging it. Thought we had a staged/commit step. Anyone else seen this?
Kevin: yikes. can you grab the browser/network payload? which endpoint did it call?
Maria: quick paste of the browser request:
```
POST /api/configs/publish
{
  "id": "route-priority-3",
  "value": {"weight": 0.1},
  "strategy": "publish"
}
```
Simon: that's the old 'publish' RPC. We added /api/configs/commit (staged) + /api/configs/activate (flip) last year — console should call commit for UI preview.
Jen: console-team: we intentionally used publish to avoid orphaned commits that sat forever. BUT we shouldn't surprise platform team. Let's sync.
Kevin: ops concern: audit logs + rollout visibility rely on commit+activate semantics. If console skips commit we lose audit-pointer and rollout diffs.
DeployBot: config-audit: commit created route-priority-3@rev-117 by Maria (ok) — no activation hook logged
Alex: telemetry point — we gate automatic activation on telemetry being enabled. If console bypasses staged path we can't enforce gating or sample checks. :warning:
Maria: idea: change UI flow to 'Save as draft' -> 'Schedule activation' and call commit; keep 'Publish now' for power users w/ confirm dialog.
Simon: API debate: do we add dry_run param to activate? e.g., POST /api/configs/activate?dry_run=true to validate sidecars and telemetry thresholds.
Jen: prefer a dedicated validate/inspect endpoint + separate activate. dry_run makes semantics leaky and complicates audit events.
Kevin: also need clear error model for partial activations (some shards accept, some reject). return 412 with structured details, not 500.
Alex: +1 on telemetry gating. propose we require a min_sample param on activate and return 429 until metrics reach it. That prevents premature flips.
Maria: I'll draft a tiny RFC and UX mocks. can console team review asap? cc @ConsoleBot
ConsoleBot: noted — creating internal task CFG-3745 — will review RFC and schedule a 30m sync.
Jen: thanks. let's not change behavior mid-week. aim for patched console behind a feature flag and 2-day litmus run. :calendar:
Kevin: agree. also add an explicit audit field 'activation_mode' with values ["publish", "commit", "activate"] so we can reconcile.
Maria: OK, I'll write the RFC and include example API shapes, sample audit events, and telemetry contract. thanks all.
